original.statement: The ValidateCAA feature gate is deprecated and scheduled for removal in cert-manager v1.18.

decision.reason: [ev-6db6001fefb2] says the `ValidateCAA` feature gate "is now deprecated, with removal scheduled for cert-manager 1.18" and that in 1.17 enabling it only prints a warning, so it still works. [ev-09a9c9047035] repeats that it is deprecated and will be removed in v1.18. Together these support a feature-gate subject named exactly ValidateCAA with change type deprecated. The text names no specific component, so leaving component unset is correct.
